preconditions.expression: isinstance(s, str) and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string s consists only of lowercase English letters.
The input k is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max((len(s[i:j]) for i in range(len(s)+1) for j in range(i, len(s)+1) if all(s[i:j].count(c) >= k for c in set(s[i:j]))), default=0)
postconditions.description: The return value is the length of the longest substring of s where every character in that substring appears at least k times within the substring. If no such non-empty substring exists, the result is 0.
